blocks.text: Structs and enums can take type parameters too. `Pair[A, B]` holds two values of two different types. Methods are written in an `impl Pair[A, B]:` block.

code: return Pair[B, A]{ first: self.second.clone(), second: self.first.clone() }

blocks.prompt: Write a `Wrapper[T]` struct holding a single value (`value: T`). Create `Wrapper[i32]{ value: 5 }` and `Wrapper[str]{ value: "hi" }` and print their values.

blocks.q: Are `Pair[i32, str]` and `Pair[f64, f64]` the same type?
blocks.why: Every combination of type arguments makes its own type.
